issues.description: getIamPolicy failure silently classifies image as PASS instead of UNKNOWN
issues.detail: When getIamPolicy raises (permission denied, transient error), the except branch logs and leaves publicly_shared=False, so the check reports PASS for an image whose policy was never read. For a security tool this is the wrong failure mode. Introduce a tri-state (or iam_policy_retrieved flag) and emit MANUAL/ERROR instead of a false negative.

issues.description: Naming inconsistency between PR title, CHANGELOG, CheckID, and data field
issues.detail: PR text and CHANGELOG reference compute_image_publicly_shared while the directory, CheckID, and class use compute_image_not_publicly_shared, and the model field is the positive publicly_shared. Pick one canonical name and align CheckID, directory, class, CHANGELOG, and the data field direction before merge.

issues.description: Bare except Exception swallows unrelated programmer faults
issues.detail: Both try blocks in _get_images catch Exception with no narrowing, so KeyError, TypeError, or malformed responses are logged as if they were API errors and the loop continues with corrupted state. Narrow the except to anticipated API exceptions and let unexpected faults surface.

issues.description: Public-member detection is complected with the I/O loop and untested as a pure function
issues.detail: _get_images interleaves project iteration, pagination, per-image IAM fetch, exception handling, and the allAuthenticatedUsers scan. Extract a pure _is_publicly_shared(iam_policy) function over bindings, document the invariant (true iff some binding grants any role to allAuthenticatedUsers), and unit-test it directly without API mocks.

issues.description: Tests never assert check-level behavior when IAM policy is unreadable
issues.detail: Fixture image 3 triggers a getIamPolicy exception and the service test only checks publicly_shared is False; no test asserts what the check reports when IAM is unreadable. The most security-relevant failure mode (unknown policy reported as PASS) is the one path not exercised end-to-end. Add a check-layer test for that case.

issues.description: Image listing precondition (custom-only) is claimed but not established or documented
issues.detail: PR text says the check evaluates custom images, but images().list(project=project_id) returns whatever the project owns with no filter (family, source, deprecated.state). Add a one-line comment establishing why project-scoped list suffices (Google-managed images live in separate projects), or enforce the filter explicitly.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on a small, working check that has one consequential security defect and one discipline defect. The security defect: a getIamPolicy failure is silently coerced to publicly_shared=False, so the check reports PASS for images whose policy was never read — and tests never exercise that path at the check layer. The discipline defect: the CheckID, directory, CHANGELOG, PR title, and data field name disagree about whether the check is positive or negative. Secondary cleanups include narrowing the bare except, extracting the bindings scan as a pure testable function with a stated invariant, and documenting the custom-image precondition.
